annotations.title: How to test a fix: agent checks and the person’s script

description: Call AFTER building or fixing something, and before telling the user it is done. For a guide (by slug) or a component (by query) returns the pass criteria, the checks the agent can run itself, the checks only a person can do (which keys to press and what should happen, as a two-minute script), the guide’s limits, and a Playwright regression test skeleton. Hand the person’s checks to the user as written; never report them as done.

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

query.description: Or a component or problem in words, when the slug is unknown

slug.description: A guide slug from find_fix or before_building
